hero.intro: Grease a wire rope inside and out in one pass, instead of by hand: pressure lubricators and pumps from Ferryl.

guidance.heading: Size it from the wire
guidance.body: Seals, scraper plates and groove cleaners are made for one wire diameter, and the groove cleaner for one construction. Give us the diameter and construction of every wire you will grease. The standard lubricator takes 1 to 50 mm; the XL takes 50 to 90 mm.

standards.heading: How pressure lubrication works
standards.body: The wire runs through a sealed chamber filled with grease at up to 400 bar. Pressure drives grease into the core and water out; scraper plates leave an even outer coat. Ferryl quotes up to 40 m/min with its 202 grease and Pump Unit.

products.title: Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator: an aluminium pressure chamber clamped round the wire that forces grease into the core at up to 400 bar, cleaning and coating in one pass at up to 40 m/min. Wires 1–50 mm; XL to 90 mm.
products.descriptionLong:
Greasing a wire rope by hand coats the outside and little else, and it takes hours on a long mooring or crane wire. The Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator does the job in one pass: the wire runs through a sealed aluminium chamber filled with grease under high pressure, which drives the grease into the core and pushes water and moisture out. The wire leaves the chamber with an even coat inside and out.

Three steps in one

  • Clean. An optional groove cleaner at the entry of the chamber scrapes off old grease, dirt and debris — Ferryl says up to 90% of it — so the new grease can reach the core.
  • Lubricate the core. Grease enters at up to 400 bar and is forced between the strands.
  • Protect the outside. Scraper plates sized to the wire leave a uniform external coat.

What it changes

Ferryl reports up to 90% less application time than manual greasing and up to 70% less re-greasing, with less waste because grease goes into the wire rather than onto the deck. Because every pass applies the same coat, no step of the maintenance is skipped.

Specification

  • Pressure up to 400 bar; grease output up to 4.5 kg/min; lubrication speed up to 40 m/min.
  • Grease intake NLGI 0 to 3; air supply 0 to 10 bar to the pump.
  • Wire sizes 1 to 50 mm (Lubricator XL: 50 to 90 mm).
  • Anodised aluminium alloy chamber, 450 mm long, 4.5 kg; 6 × 1/2" female BSP connections.

The figures are Ferryl's, measured with Ferryl 202 Standard grease and the Ferryl Pump Unit; other pumps and greases may give different results.

What is in the case

Lubricating chamber, carry case, a set of seals and a set of scraper plates for the wire diameter ordered, a spare seal set, and self-retracting ratchet straps to anchor the chamber. Seals, scraper plates and groove cleaners are made for each wire diameter (and the groove cleaner for the wire construction), so tell us the wire size and construction when you order.

Suitable wires

Crane, hoist and luffing wires, mooring and towing wires, and ramp wires.

products.title: Ferryl Pump Unit for Wire Rope Lubricator
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl Pump Unit: an air-powered, high-pressure grease pump on a pneumatic ram press and trolley, built to feed the Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator a steady flow of grease straight from the drum.
products.descriptionLong:
The Ferryl Wire Rope Lubricator works with many grease pumps, but Ferryl developed the Pump Unit to get the most from it. An air-driven high-pressure, high-output grease pump sits on a pneumatic ram press that follows the grease down the drum, so the pump is never starved and the chamber gets a steady, controlled flow.

Why use it

  • Air powered — runs from the ship's compressed-air supply.
  • High pressure and high output to fill the lubricating chamber.
  • Pneumatic ram press pushes stiff grease into the pump intake.
  • Simple controls and a wheeled frame for moving round the deck.
  • Ferryl's published lubricator figures (400 bar, 4.5 kg/min, 40 m/min) were measured with this pump.

Designed for Ferryl 202 Standard grease. Confirm the drum size and air supply with us before ordering.

  • Ferryl 202 White wire rope grease
  • Ferryl 202 Aluminium grease paint
